column1: # rubric.tsv — the sections of the gradekit warrant set, one per test module, in document order.

column2: The Reading: A Record File Is Parsed Into the Ladder's Json Type or Refused by Name
The Options: Repeatable Options Are Taken and an Unknown or Valueless One Is a Usage Error
The Verdict: One Compact Record Is Written Atomically and Every Aggregate Names Its Offenders
The Reading: A Calculation Record Becomes a Grade With Its Whole Justification
The Table: Grade Records Join the Metadata and the Clamp Is Applied Over the Graded Claims
The Effective Grade: Edges From the Bibs Join the Grade Files and the Clamp Honours Owner Grades
